question: Queen Padmavati is related to which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittaurgarh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Queen Padmavati, also known as Rani Padmini, is traditionally associated with **Chittaurgarh**.
 
• She **was the queen of Chittaurgarh and is renowned for her beauty** and valor, as well as the legend of her self-sacrifice (Jauhar) to protect her honor during Alauddin Khilji's siege of Chittorgarh.
 
• The** Delhi Sultan Alauddin Khilji, captivated by tales of Padmini's beauty, attacked Chittaurgarh to capture her.**
 
• Despite a fierce defense, the fort eventually fell.
 
• This **16th-century epic poem romanticized Rani Padmini's story**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chittaurgarh Fort**:

 
 
• This** massive fort is a UNESCO World Heritage Site **and is deeply linked with the legend of Rani Padmini.
 
• The fort has **84 water bodies**, including reservoirs, ponds, and stepwells, of which about 22 remain functional today.
 
• The fort was attacked three major times:
 
 
• **1303 CE**: By Alauddin Khilji.
 
• **1535 CE**: By Bahadur Shah of Gujarat.
 
• **1567 CE**: By Emperor Akbar.
 
 
 
• The fort served as the capital of the Mewar kingdom and witnessed the dramatic events surrounding Rani Padmini.
